fact: The paper states that the Harmonized Births and Deaths Registration Portal, launched in 2022, was rolled out across all sixteen regions in January 2024 and is now the primary system for handling birth and death registrations, while Ghana has no e-death notification and relies on partly manual processes for deaths.
title: Enhancing Death Registration in Ghana Through Technology: Drawing Lessons from Namibia's Death Registration System
publisher: 2026 CRVS Research Forum (UNECA CRVS mentor, Ghana, and co-authors)
